topic: What actually drives the cost of an app
caption:
“How much does an app cost?” The honest answer: it depends on 5 things, and the number of screens usually isn't one of them. 💡

1️⃣ How many platforms
2️⃣ How many user types

slides.title: What actually drives the cost of an app.
slides.sub: Hint: it's rarely the number of screens.

slides.title: How many platforms
slides.body: iOS, Android, web, or all three? Each platform adds design, testing and release work. Cross-platform can reduce it.

slides.title: How many user types
slides.body: A customer app, a driver app and an admin panel are three products, not one.

slides.title: Integrations
slides.body: Payments, maps, SMS, third-party APIs. Every integration adds setup, edge cases and testing.

slides.title: Real-time features
slides.body: Live chat, tracking and instant updates need extra backend work and careful scaling.

slides.title: Design complexity
slides.body: Custom animations and bespoke UI take longer than clean, proven patterns. Polish where it matters most.
